fields.quoted_span: Seattle’s ordinance expressly prohibits specified algorithmic coordinating services and provides penalties of up to $7,500 per violation.
fields.note: The document supports the prohibition and the penalty. 'Used to set rents in Seattle rental housing' is a mild paraphrase; the document describes use in connection with Seattle multifamily properties.

fields.quoted_span: provides penalties of up to $7,500 per violation
fields.note: The table says penalties 'may reach $7,500 per violation', which is consistent.
The rule's effective_date is empty. The document gives only 'effective July 2025' (month only), so no exact date is stated. The rule's effective_date_note says the same.

fields.quoted_span: Seattle Mun. Code ch. 7.34 (effective July 2025) | Prohibits specified coordinating services; penalties may reach $7,500 per violation; now at issue in Nicolas v. Essex Management Corp., et al., (W.D. Wash.)
fields.note: The ordinance is described as effective July 2025 and as currently at issue in litigation, which is consistent with in_force. The document does not state 'in force' in so many words.
The coverage fields are all empty. The document states no covered properties, thresholds, or exemptions for Seattle.

The document cites 'ch. 7.34.040' for the penalty and 'Chapter 7.34' for the ordinance. The section-level form § 7.34.040 is an inference, as the rule's review_note admits. The alias ch. 7.34 is supported.
